generated_by: benchmark-v2/validator/receipt.py::tree_hash — the SAME function the signed receipt's code_roots binds
rule: sha256 over the concatenation, in ascending byte order of the LINES themselves, of one line per file: <relpath> NUL <sha256-hex-of-file-bytes> LF, utf-8 encoded. relpath is POSIX-separated and relative to the tree root. Directories named __pycache__, .pytest_cache or evidence are skipped WHEREVER they occur, together with everything beneath them; files whose name ends in .pyc are skipped. Named key-material paths are skipped and their ABSENCE is not an error (a key-free image and a minting host must agree). Empty directories contribute nothing. An empty tree hashes to sha256 of the empty string.

vectors.name: single-file
vectors.why: the base case: one file, one line, one sha256 of that line

vectors.name: empty-file
vectors.why: a zero-byte file still contributes a line (sha256 of b'')

vectors.name: empty-tree
vectors.why: a tree with nothing hashable hashes to sha256(b'') — not to an error

vectors.name: line-order-not-path-order
vectors.why: the sort is over the LINES, so 'b.py' precedes 'b/a.py' ('.' 0x2E < '/' 0x2F). An implementation that sorted by path COMPONENTS would order these the other way round and produce a different root

vectors.name: nested-deeply
vectors.why: relpaths are POSIX-joined all the way down, never basenames

vectors.name: excluded-dirs-are-invisible
vectors.why: __pycache__, .pytest_cache and evidence are skipped WHEREVER they occur; this vector must hash identically to 'nested-deeply'

vectors.name: pyc-suffix-is-skipped-outside-pycache-too
vectors.why: the suffix rule is independent of the directory rule

vectors.name: dotfiles-and-odd-names-are-INCLUDED
vectors.why: only the three named directories and the .pyc suffix are excluded; a dotfile or a file with no extension is ordinary tree content and must be hashed

vectors.name: utf8-names-and-content
vectors.why: the line is utf-8 encoded, so a non-ASCII name or body must not change the rule

vectors.name: binary-content-with-nuls
vectors.why: file BYTES are hashed, never decoded; a NUL inside a file must not be confused with the NUL that separates relpath from digest in a line

vectors.name: key-material-excluded-present
vectors.why: the validator tree's private seed is not identity-bearing; this vector and 'key-material-excluded-absent' MUST hash identically, which is what lets a key-free image reproduce a minting host's receipt

vectors.name: key-material-excluded-absent
vectors.why: a MISSING excluded path is fine — that is the whole point of the exclusion

vectors.name: content-sensitivity
vectors.why: a one-BYTE edit to one file must move the root; this vector is 'single-file' with 'print(1)' -> 'print(2)'

vectors.name: name-sensitivity
vectors.why: renaming a file must move the root even though its bytes are unchanged
